strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Barrancos acredi: The Canyoning Sports Technician accredits specific training to guide descents with rope, water, rappelling, jumps, slides and progression on technical terrain. Rescue 3 Swiftwater Rescue Technician is specialist training in quick water, current and flood rescue. Training in hydrology helps to read river flows, slipstreams, currents and hazards. The basic mechanics of BTT allow us to resolve common incidents on mountain bike routes.
strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Escalada acredit: The Sports Climbing Technician accredits specific training in vertical progression, wall safety, belaying and management of rope activities. IRATA type training is related to vertical work and technical maneuvers at height. Self-rescue and vertical rescue allow action in the event of blockages, rope incidents or evacuations in exposed areas. Dynamic systems are especially important because these jumps generate different forces than a conventional rappel or climb.
strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Espeleología acr: The Sports Technician in Speleology accredits preparation to guide activities in caves, chasms and underground environments with technical criteria. Vertical rope progression allows you to work in wells, ledges and uneven areas. Self-help in cavities is essential because underground help may take longer to arrive. The topography and underground orientation help interpret routes, galleries and exit points. The conservation of cavities ensures a respectful practice with geological formations and sensitive ecosystems.
strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Media Montaña ac: The Mid-Mountain Sports Technician accredits preparation to guide in non-technical terrain, plan routes and manage groups. Orientation and cartography allow you to move with a map, compass, GPS and terrain references. Bushcraft brings together traditional autonomy skills such as shelter, fire, water, knots and reading the environment. Remote first aid is essential when assistance may take time.
strings.El título de Técnico Deportivo en Escala: The title of Sports Technician in Climbing and Medium Mountains accredits specific training to guide, teach and manage mountain activities with technical and safety criteria. Training in self-rescue, installation of belays and rope progression allows you to act in complex situations on walls, ferratas or rappels. First aid in remote areas reinforces the response capacity when an activity takes place far from immediate assistance.

strings.La formación como guía de kayak de mar e: Training as a sea kayak guide and SUP instructor accredits knowledge to direct activities in coastal environments, control groups and adapt the route to the level of the participant. Aquatic lifesaving and open water rescue are key to acting in the event of falls, fatigue, currents or problems during the activity. Coastal navigation and maritime meteorology allow us to interpret wind, waves, access points, departure points and changes in conditions at sea.
strings.La formación como instructor de parapent: Training as a paragliding, paramotor and paratrike instructor accredits the ability to teach flight progression, glider control, takeoffs, landings and air safety. The two-seater rating allows flights with a passenger. SIV training works on the simulation of incidents in flight, such as crashes or recovery maneuvers, in a controlled environment. USPA Coach/AFF is related to skydiving training, especially student progression and supervised jumps.
strings.La formación como instructor de SUP, win: Training as a SUP, wingfoil and kitesurf instructor accredits the ability to teach board and wind sports progressively, from basic balance to direction control, speed and safety. Specific e-foil training focuses on the use of electric foil boards, battery control, safe falls and safety distance. Aquatic lifesaving, rescue with a support boat and wind and wave reading are essential for working in the open sea or areas with maritime traffic.

strings.PADI y SSI son dos de las organizaciones: PADI and SSI are two of the most recognized international organizations for diving training. Being a Master Instructor, Instructor Trainer or Rescue Diver Instructor implies experience training students and the ability to teach safety, rescue and underwater emergency management techniques. Nitrox allows diving with oxygen-enriched mixtures. Deep focuses on deep dives. Search & Recovery focuses on underwater search and recovery. DAN Oxygen Provider accredits training in oxygen administration in diving emergencies.

strings.UAS significa sistema aéreo no tripulado: UAS stands for unmanned aerial system, i.e. drones and remotely piloted aircraft. The A1/A3 and A2 certificates certify knowledge to operate drones within European regulations according to the type of flight, the environment and the distance from people. STS training is aimed at more specific and planned operations. The FPV flight allows piloting by viewing the image from the drone's camera, but requires special technical control and, when appropriate, observer support. Their training in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere, color, sound and image rights allows them to deliver professional content without compromising the security of the activity.
